text_block_list.text:
One day, just shortly before
Seiun Sky's debut—

text_block_list.name: Spe & Grass
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah...! 
Fuuh...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Grass-chan, one more lap!
(Special Week. An Umamusume who runs full steam toward becoming the best in Japan, armed with a razor-sharp finishing kick.)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu... That's just what I'm hoping for~

(Grass Wonder.
An Umamusume hiding a fierce fighting spirit
beneath her gentle demeanor.)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh, both of them are on fire!
King, let's go run too!
(El Condor Pasa. An Umamusume aiming to be the world's strongest, who showed glimpses of that potential in her debut race.)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Very well! I'll show you
the true power of the King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san's Trainer?
I'll grant you the privilege of timing my run!

As for why I'm helping with training someone other than Seiun Sky...
the story goes back a little while.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Sei-chan!
Heyyy!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: *sigh* You finally made it... Wait, why are you in your school uniform?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Because Trainer and I
are having a meeting right now."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hah!?
What happened to our joint training!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Joint training?
Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure I called out yesterday at lunch,
'Let's all do tandem running together' though!?
If that's true, it's more than I could ever ask for. Every single one of them is a promising prospect fresh off their debut.
In other words, she could become a rival standing in Seiun Sky's way in their generation. I'd like to get a read on her true strength, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I feel like King told us yesterday,
"Let's all train side-by-side"... though.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So you DO remember!!
Are you seriously kidding me right now?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Now, now~. King-chan, you were waiting because
you thought Sei-chan would come too, weren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —There's no way Sei-chan would miss a chance to gather intel~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...You're giving me too much credit~
I mean, I totally forgot about it until just now, you know?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my~. So you went all the way outside
just to have a quick meeting, did you~?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, hasn't an entirely different battle started here?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hawawa, let's quickly correct our course, yes!
Sei-chan, please go get changed!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Sei-chan's Trainer...
Please help El and the others first, *desu*!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay~. Well then Trainer,
—make sure to watch reeeal closely, okay~?

And so, I was watching Special Week
and the others train, but—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Every single one of them is a wonderful Umamusume...!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Just kidding~ But your inner thoughts
are leaking out completely, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Judging by your expression, it looks like you took
a loooong, careful "look" at everyone, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So you realized it, huh?
...Just how strong those girls really are.

Seiun Sky watched Special Week and the others out of the corner of her eye.
Her gaze was dead serious.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So, how did you feel about it, Trainer-san?
Starting with Spe-chan—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Sei-chan~. Since you've changed,
would you like to go for a run with me~?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...I won't let you get a head start
all by yourself, you know."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Aha. Could you let it slide just this once~... guess not.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
just watch from over there~

And so, after watching over their
joint training session for a while...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—King-chan and El-chan said
they'll need a little more time!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
King really takes forever getting ready, after all~.
I bet El got dragged into waiting around with her.
choice_data_list: Everyone really gets along well, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, we belong to the same generation, after all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Sei-chan's Trainer!
Thank you so much for today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Not only did you lend a hand,
you brought refreshments too!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "If anything, I was happy I got to play with such adorable Umamusume~☆" ...apparently.

I got cut off...
I suppose that means I shouldn't say anything unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Still, once Sei-chan makes her debut,
we probably won't have many chances
to gather together like this, will we?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
As we each walk our own paths—
I suppose there will be many chances to compete in the future, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, in the Twinkle Series...!
I can finally run with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I know how strong everyone is... but still!
I'm definitely not giving up the Japanese Derby!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's Spe-chan's dream, after all.
To be the number one horse girl in Japan... right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm gonna win the Derby
and give Mom the gift of being number one in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Spe-chan really is
so wonderfully straightforward~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which, Grass-chan, what's your reason for running, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...There is only one reason.
To master the path of racing—and reach the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That is what I aim for.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Waaaahhh!
Sei-chan's completely done for~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Because, because!
We're about to compete against all those dream-filled☆
talented girls, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Just because I was born in this era...
Don't you think I'm truly an unfortunate Umamusume?
Their presence is certainly a threat. However, Seiun Sky's words probably don't reflect what she truly feels.
choice_data_list: If anything, you should consider yourself lucky.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Oh?
That's quite a confident statement.
choice_data_list: Because challenging fishing is much more fun.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha! You really are
a tricky one to read, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, honestly, I just want to take things
as easy as possible, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if my Trainer is that pumped up...
I guess I’ve got no choice but to pull ahead of the pack, huh♪”
